description: Composed transaction-receipt verification (SPEC-v2 §5.7). Decode receipt_b64 and call VerifyTransactionReceiptV2 with now, future_skew_seconds, the trust provider, status evidence provider, SecurityJournalV2 store, status_keys and status_policy built exactly as in verifier-ordering.json. expected.error_class: the call fails with that class. expected.result: the exact result; status_evidence_digests is in the canonical order of SPEC-v2 §5.8.

semantics.status_evidence: as in verifier-ordering.json; an issuer without an entry returns an empty batch
semantics.trust: as in verifier-ordering.json; null = no trust provider

vectors.name: all_current
vectors.description: trusted root, current delegations and status, covered scope

vectors.name: trust_untrusted
vectors.description: available trust configuration excludes the chain: every later dimension is not_evaluated

vectors.name: trust_ambiguous
vectors.description: an ambiguous trust resolution is unavailable, never trusted

vectors.name: leaf_revoked
vectors.description: the leaf certificate is revoked by its issuer's signed list

vectors.name: status_issuer_unconfigured
vectors.description: an issuer without a caller-authenticated status key is unavailable; the other issuer's evidence is reported

vectors.name: leaf_expired
vectors.description: a leaf whose expires_at equals now is expired (exclusive deadline); delegation_expires_at is the earliest expiry

vectors.name: leaf_issued_in_future
vectors.description: a leaf issued more than future_skew_seconds after now is invalid

vectors.name: parent_without_identity_delegate
vectors.description: the root certificate omits identity:delegate: scope_assessment delegation_not_authorized

vectors.name: scope_not_covered
vectors.description: the signed required scope is outside the effective delegated scope

vectors.name: configuration_invalid_now
vectors.description: an evaluation time outside the timestamp domain fails before decoding with configuration_invalid

vectors.name: configuration_invalid_skew
vectors.description: a future skew above 300 seconds fails with configuration_invalid
